response.overview: Released during the peak of her popularity, Selen Live (1997) captures the electric, charismatic energy of Italian adult cinema icon Luce Caponegro, better known as Selen. Breaking away from traditional narrative structures, the film offers a more intimate and documentary-like approach, placing Selen in dynamic, uninhibited scenarios that feel both spontaneous and deeply passionate. Through highly charged vignettes and direct engagement with the camera, the feature highlights her undeniable allure and playful confidence, serving as a vibrant tribute to a star who effortlessly commanded the screen and captivated European audiences throughout the 1990s.
response.title: Selen Live 1
